headline: Police and Coast Guard Tighten Security at Flood-Control Facilities After Theft
seoTitle: Security Tightened at Metro Manila Pumping Stations | FMB News
seoDescription: Police and Coast Guard personnel strengthened security around Metro Manila pumping stations and flood-control facilities after theft disrupted operations.
deck: Authorities increased protection of critical drainage infrastructure after stolen equipment disrupted flood-mitigation operations.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine National Police ordered stronger security around MMDA pumping stations and other flood-control facilities after theft of vital equipment disrupted flood-mitigation operations.
Coast Guard personnel were also deployed to help secure facilities including the Sunog Apog pumping station in Manila.

sections.heading: Why the facilities matter
paragraphs: Pumping stations move stormwater out of low-lying communities and are especially critical during prolonged monsoon rainfall. Damage or theft can reduce drainage capacity when flooding risk is already high.

sections.heading: Response
paragraphs: Police commanders were told to coordinate with government agencies, local governments and facility operators, especially in flood-prone areas.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Protecting flood-control equipment is part of disaster readiness: infrastructure that exists on paper cannot reduce flooding if it is disabled when storms arrive.
